text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,044.65, up 0.06% for the day and 6.84% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.47% (5‑day gain 5.96%). Advances outpaced declines (314 vs 174) giving a healthy breadth score of 71.8, and the market stayed above its 20‑day, 50‑day and 200‑day moving averages (75.3%, 52.1% and 49.3% of stocks respectively). The India VIX fell 0.29% to 17.42, indicating lower volatility.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) pumped ₹7,212 crore into equities, offset by a DII outflow of ₹7,173 crore, leaving net buying of about ₹39 crore. The leading sectors were Pharma, Private Bank and Capital Markets, while IT and Infrastructure showed weakness. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.07 for Nifty, a max‑pain level at 25,000 and a call wall at 26,000, suggesting some resistance near that level; Bank Nifty PCR is 1.27 with max‑pain at 57,700 and a call/put wall at 58,000.

Watch the 25,000‑25,140 range for Nifty and the 59,165‑60,029 band for Bank Nifty, with key pivots at 24,894 (S1) and 24,989 (P). Next‑session cues will come from any move in the USD‑INR (now 93.92) and global cues such as US equity rebounds. A break above the call wall could trigger further buying, while a slip below the put wall may invite fresh selling.
